Engineering process

Measure first. Enforce in code.

Fixed-scope engineering engagements led directly by the founder, backed by reproducible evaluation harnesses.

01

Define failure boundaries

We map your retrieval corpus, target languages, latency budget and unacceptable failure modes—establishing an explicit contract before touching prompts or weights.

02

Build the verification harness

We implement deterministic span checks, schema validators and an adversarial golden dataset that runs automatically on every commit.

03

Benchmark & hand over

We measure throughput, accuracy and cost across candidate runtimes and deliver clean, documented production code with zero vendor lock-in.

Engineering & partnerships

Discuss an architecture audit or private preview access.

Tell us about your retrieval pipeline, target languages, runtime constraints and timeline. Enquiries go directly to the founder.
